doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Upcoming gigs and tours
summary: He lists gigs in Brooklyn, St. John's Island, Denmark, Berlin, Montreal, and the Elvin Jones Live at the Lighthouse tribute.

bands.name: Elvin Jones Live at the Lighthouse 50th Anniversary band

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s coming up in the near future for you? You’ve got the summer off?

No, I’ve got a gig in Brooklyn Thursday but then I’m coming — I have to go to St. John’s Island, I’ve got a gig up there with Jim Vivian, a great bass player. He got a grant to have me just come up there and do a concert. And then I’m going to Europe to Denmark for two and a half weeks, mostly Denmark. I’m going to Berlin for a couple of days. Then I come home and go to Montreal to do a recording with Remi Bolduc, a great

alto player who teaches at McGill, doing a jazz camp in August, Jazz in the Mountains in Vermont, and September — oh June 30 also September 2 and September 4 I’m playing with the Elvin Jones 50th Anniversary of Live at the Lighthouse with Dave Liebman, Gene Perla, Adam Nussbaum. We’re playing those tunes from that album.
